evidence.text: Data Scientist, Marrick Building Services (pump and HVAC maintenance), April 2021 to May 2024. Built a gradient-boosted model that predicts pump bearing failures within 30 days from vibration and run-hour logs collected from 2,600 monitored pumps.
evidence.notes: The candidate built a failure-prediction model from equipment event logs.

evidence.text: Packaged the model as a versioned container with a model card and pytest checks on the input schema, built through the team's CI pipeline, and stored each version in the team's model registry.
evidence.notes: The candidate packaged the model for deployment with versioned artefacts and automated tests.

evidence.text: Deployed the model into the production work-order planner on 19 September 2023 (planner release 4.2), where each alert creates an inspection task for planners; tracked alert precision weekly for the following quarter from the planner's own logs.
evidence.notes: The candidate deployed the model into a production system and monitored it after release.

evidence.text: Agreed an alert-handling procedure with five field supervisors, with a 48-hour inspection target and a feedback code for false alarms, written up as a one-page procedure for the planners.
evidence.notes: The candidate worked with field teams to agree how model alerts are acted on.

evidence.text: Posted the weekly alert-precision figures in the maintenance planning team's channel.
evidence.notes: The candidate posted the weekly alert-precision figures, but it is unclear if this was reported to operations management each month.
